git_rationale.root_cause_commit: cfc5766 -- fix: realistic prices + shopping merge bug (introduced _parse_shopping_brands workaround pattern)
git_rationale.why_issue_occurred: Shopping schema had no nested field for brand data. Brands were encoded into notes_base free text using [CATEGORY] bracket syntax. A 94-line regex parser (_parse_shopping_brands) was added to recover structure at render time. This pattern is fragile, untestable, and prevents typed schema validation.
git_rationale.how_fix_addresses_root: Added brands array to the schema so agents can output typed brand objects directly. HTML generator reads brands array first (skipping regex parse). Fallback preserved for all existing plans that predate this change.
